intervention: Reconstruct entire original MLP1 product write with frozen candidate, preserving Down bias. Add exact native donor-minus-recipient delta from M57 at original selected positions. metrics: Native probability weighted final logprob response error, pooled numerator/native-energy denominator

validation: Replay every native baseline/target and compare hashes of saved deltas; zero identities and ineligible rows retained. Independently rescore saved final output vectors. No new fit or training holdout exposure.
stop: One complete comparison, no task/site/seed/candidate selection or optimizer search. Use findings to specify causal-supervision changes only afterward with matched controls. Training-bank fidelity is not transfer or new-task discovery.
scope: Previously examined source-group/lexical development holdouts; not pristine evaluation, whole-task transfer, semantic-unit validation, or discovery.
